Standard: In forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) and without retrimming, push forces on the longitudinal controller increase speed and pull forces decrease airspeed, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the forward flight longitudinal static stability as specified in MIL- DTL-32742 Longitudinal Static Stability paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the forward flight longitudinal static stability as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Longitudinal Static Stability paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the forward flight longitudinal static stability as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Longitudinal Static Stability paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
